notes: Lane B owns layer=swarm items only. docker_stack / docker_stacks / stack services are layer cli-only in inventory.json (cli-only:stack, cli-only:stack-services, cli-only:stacks), so stack_yaml / compose_spec_version are not in this file; the lane that owns cli-only should add them.

Structured outputs are named `inspect` (single object; raw `inspect_json` serializes it) or the plural type name for list data sources (`services` + `services_json`). Address example: docker_service.x.inspect.spec.task_template.container_spec.image.

fields were generated mechanically from swagger.yaml (API 1.56) by following $ref / allOf / items / additionalProperties to the leaves, so every upstream name is a real property; fields_complete true means the whole tree is listed. Snake_case keeps acronym runs together (NanoCPUs -> nano_cpus, SELinuxContext -> selinux_context, ExternalCAs -> external_cas, VirtualIPs -> virtual_ips, TLSInfo -> tls_info).
Objects with neither properties nor additionalProperties in the swagger are tf_type dynamic (e.g. ServiceSpec.Mode.Global, GlobalJob).
version_index (swarm object Version.Index) is identity, never the version category; version outputs are only engine_api_version / docker_server_version from GET /version (SystemVersion).
known_after_apply: resources and actions true (computed by create / invoke); data sources false (they read existing objects; unknown only when an argument comes from an unapplied resource).

Sensitive: service/task inspect and lists (ContainerSpec.Env/Args/Command), join tokens, unlock key, logs. Secret inspect is not sensitive because the Engine never returns SecretSpec.Data. The swarm inspect excludes JoinTokens (separate sensitive join_tokens) and relies on the daemon redacting Spec.CAConfig.SigningCAKey (swarmkit redacts it on GetCluster; the swagger still lists the field) - unverified against a live daemon.
Hash outputs (content_sha256) are not sensitive even when their raw output is: a SHA-256 does not reveal the value.
naming_questions: Raw output for service/task logs (no upstream JSON): `logs_text` (this lane) vs `logs` vs a list like the container logs data source's existing `logs_list_string`; should every log data source share one name?
docker_swarm_init exposes the cluster ID today as `cluster_id`; the contract uses `id` = ClusterInfo.ID. Keep `cluster_id` as an alias, or drop it?
Plural data sources: structured list named after the type (`services`, `nodes`, ...) with raw `<plural>_json` (this lane), or a uniform `items` / `items_json` across every plural data source?

Service/task `inspect` is sensitive as a whole because ContainerSpec.Env may hold secrets, which makes `inspect.spec.task_template.container_spec.image` sensitive too. Keep whole-object sensitivity plus non-sensitive copies (image_digest_ref, replicas, published_ports), or add a redacted `inspect_redacted` (Env/Args/Command blanked)?
Action identity for the target: `node_id` / `service_id` (this lane) or plain `id` like resources?
